expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's recruitment strategy and service standards - lead the choice and use of recruitment technology and agencies - make sure recruitment is inclusive and lawful across the organisation

You can: - build talent pipelines and communities for scarce digital and data roles - shape the employer value proposition with hiring teams - use market data on pay and supply to advise on hard-to-fill roles - develop early careers routes, such as apprenticeships and graduate schemes

You can: - analyse workforce data to find trends and explain them to managers - design dashboards and reports for workforce indicators - produce statutory and equality reporting, such as pay gap analysis
You can: - apply people policies to routine cases and explain them to managers - identify the employment law principles behind a policy - keep policy records and track policy review dates
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - carry out equality impact assessments - build inclusive teams and practices
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
